title: Five-domain claim-evidence reconciliation for the Intel and Homes for Ukraine receipts
question: Can the two frozen Intel and Homes for Ukraine repository-content candidates be authorized as candidate evidence for their exact narrow claims, joining the three prior admissions across all five Sprint 03 domains while preserving every realization, remedy, durability, governance, answer-effectiveness, and issue-closure deficit?

authority.authorization_basis: The repository owner directed continuation after both bounded repository-content candidates and their fail-closed qualification harnesses were merged. Publication and merge of this exact reconciliation supplies repository-level authority for only the two frozen claims to enter candidate evidence alongside the three previously adjudicated claims.
authority.authorized_evidence_scope: candidate evidence for the two exact frozen claims only

adjudications.authorized_claim: The official record establishes that the United States Department of Commerce exchanged $8.8698 billion of accelerated CHIPS and Secure Enclave disbursement authority for an executed Intel common-stock, escrowed-share, and conditional-warrant package; closing issued 274,583,000 shares and a warrant for up to 240,516,150 shares; three million escrowed shares had been released by fiscal year-end 2025 and a further 13 million during the six months ended 27 June 2026, approximately 16 million cumulatively, leaving approximately 143 million in escrow, while no sale, dividend, warrant exercise, realized federal cash receipt, or public or affected-party distribution is observed in the bounded record.

Official records establish that MHCLG began building Share in summer 2024, migrated three years of operational data, delivered the service in September 2025, exited the former supplier contract, and continued operating and modifying Share through at least 17 August 2026; current guidance and grant conditions require councils to use Share for safeguarding, accommodation, and reporting workflows, while a public MHCLG repository at commit 120e42a871937c2f8f34d1f84c24cd194791551b provides runnable source, automated tests, MIT-licensed MHCLG code custody, and release history through version 2.10.0. The same bounded record identifies Made Tech support and London-hosted cloud infrastructure and does not establish independent end-to-end migration assurance, a Palantir deletion certificate or residual-copy inventory, supplier-free or cloud-independent operation, affected-party governance, or independently reconciled savings and service performance.

scope_note: All five Sprint 03 domains now carry candidate evidence for exact bounded claims. That five-domain evidence denominator does not establish any composed durable answer: Intel still lacks realization and distribution, HFU still lacks independent migration assurance, residual-custody closure, remedy, durability, and affected-party governance, and the prior three domains retain their published implementation deficits.
